templates.title: Five-section contents
templates.notes: Five-item agenda verified against two source originals. Editable English labels; original panel masks, gradients and clipped edge panels retained.
templates.reconstruction: Measured five-item SVG composition with native editable text.
intentional_differences: Inter replaces SF Pro; English neutral labels replace example content.
The title text area extends into the empty left column; anchor, font and canvas are unchanged.

Text sizes calibrated for the shared 0.95 Inter scale; title and item left anchors compensate glyph side bearings. Original panels, source canvas and uniform composition scale are unchanged. Inter glyph widths and English text intentionally differ from SF Pro outlines.
User-requested vertical centering: editable item text is centered by its actual typeset height in each original panel; font size and left alignment remain fixed.

templates.title: Team presentation

intentional_differences: Inter replaces SF Pro in the editable statistic fields.
Industry members is the neutral fourth caption; the team helper restores Working in Bitcoin.
Text inside the supplied collage remains part of its replaceable artwork.
